text:
kai: Heads up — hit a weird one on macOS with Homebrew redwoodctl 0.12.1. I created a profile named `team/alpha` and now `redwoodctl local-serve` fails because the CLI created a directory instead of a profile file.

kai: Repro steps:
```bash
$ redwoodctl init --profile team/alpha
Created profile \"team/alpha\" at /Users/kai/.config/redwood/profiles/team/alpha.json
$ redwoodctl local-serve --profile=team/alpha
Error: open /Users/kai/.config/redwood/profiles/team: is a directory
```

elaine: OSX version? shell? did you install from Homebrew or the binary? :thinking:

kai: macOS 13.6 (arm64), installed via brew, zsh. redwoodctl v0.12.1. `ls ~/.config/redwood/profiles` shows a `team` dir with `alpha.json` inside, so the CLI treated the slash like a path separator when writing.

sam: ah yeah this is a serialization vs naming bug. We treat profile identifiers as plain strings but then use them as filesystem paths without encoding. Quick workaround: rename the file to a flat name and update the index, e.g.
```
mv ~/.config/redwood/profiles/team/alpha.json ~/.config/redwood/profiles/team-alpha.json
# then update any config reference that points to \"team/alpha\"
```
Works locally but sucks for infra that generates profile names (our infra sometimes outputs names with slashes).

kai: CI pipelines broke because our infra outputs names like `org/env/service` — failing on agents that run local-serve during integration tests. Need a proper fix.

omar: I can reproduce on darwin/arm64. Will open an issue and tag eng-runtime. We should treat profile ids as opaque and encode when mapping to disk (or use a profiles index file keyed by raw id). Fix should be small — either percent-encode `/` -> `%2F` or base64 the filename.

devex-bot: :eyes: Issue #4523 created: \"redwoodctl: profile ids with '/' create nested dirs instead of file — local-serve fails\" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/4523

sam: short-term workaround: avoid `/` in profile names or use percent-encoding when creating profiles:
```
# create an encoded profile name
redwoodctl init --profile team%2Falpha
```
That will create a literal file name with `%2F` and local-serve will work. Not ideal but unblocks things.

elaine: can you attach the `strace`/dtruss or a small repro? I'll propose a sanitizer in the installer and a follow-up to change the on-disk layout to a single `profiles.json` index mapping raw ids -> file ids.

kai: will add a minimal repro and attach CI logs. thanks all, will use the %2F workaround for now and watch #4523. :thumbsup:
